say:1:1460152001:1.text: Welcome to Persena's magic shop! It's great to have you here, my esteemed guest.
say:1:1460152001:1.source_cn: 欢迎来到珀瑟娜的魔饰坊！本店又迎来了一位尊贵的客人！
say:1:1460152001:1.male: Welcome to Persena's magic shop! It's great to have you here, my esteemed guest.
say:1:1460152001:1.female: Welcome to Persena's magic shop! It's great to have you here, my esteemed guest.

say:2:1460152002:1.text: We take pride in offering only the finest goods, worthy of the distinguished elite of the royal city.
say:2:1460152002:1.source_cn: 如您所见，本店没有凡俗之物，只有王城中最尊贵的存在才配...
say:2:1460152002:1.male: We take pride in offering only the finest goods, worthy of the distinguished elite of the royal city.

say:3:1460152003:1.text: I assure you that every charm here is a masterpiece. There's simply nothing better out there.
say:3:1460152003:1.source_cn: 每件魔饰都蕴含着强大的魔力，设计上也是别具巧思，最能彰...

say:3:1460152003:1.female: I assure you that every charm here is a masterpiece. There's simply nothing better out there.

say:4:1460152004:1.text: I've got quite the clientele—royals, nobles, even priests and priestesses shop here regularly.
say:4:1460152004:1.source_cn: 无论是王公贵族，还是高阶祭司，都对本店的魔饰爱不释手。

say:4:1460152004:1.female: I've got quite the clientele—royals, nobles, even priests and priestesses shop here regularly.
